Contact.hero_desc: Have questions about your certificates? Our support team is available to assist with verification and account inquiries.
Contact.email_desc: For general inquiries, account issues, or institutional partnership opportunities.
Contact.chat_desc: Real-time assistance for verification issues. Available Mon-Fri, 9am - 5pm EST.
Contact.faq_1_a: Yes. You can generate and download unlimited PDF certificates for free. Verification features require a free account.
Contact.faq_2_q: How long do verification links last?
Contact.faq_2_a: Verification links are permanent as long as the issuing account remains active and in good standing with our terms of service.
Contact.faq_3_q: How can I get a Verified Business badge?
Contact.faq_3_a: We automatically verify accounts that sign up with a custom institutional domain (e.g., registrar@university.edu). Gmail/Yahoo accounts require manual review.

Verify.hero_desc: Enter the 12-digit verification code found on the document to validate its authenticity against the public ledger.
Verify.error_length: The code must be 12 characters long.
Verify.integrity_desc: Unlike a PDF edited in Photoshop, a verified record is pulled directly from our secure database. The details you see are exactly what was issued.
Verify.identity_desc: Verification validates <italic>who</italic> issued the award. We confirm the organization exists, preventing "fake degree" scams.
Verify.diag_caption: The code instantly fetches the original, untampered record.
Verify.feat_perm_desc: Paper gets lost. Digital records are stored permanently in the cloud, accessible 24/7.
Verify.feat_inst_desc: Verification happens in milliseconds, speeding up background checks.
Verify.feat_org_desc: Issuers who upgrade get a "Verified Organization" badge for massive credibility.

SmartBulk.hero_desc: Upload raw data exports from HR software or event platforms. Our ingestion engine identifies columns automatically, eliminating manual data cleaning.
SmartBulk.legacy_desc: Standard bulk tools rely on rigid templates. If a column is named "Student Name" instead of "Name", the import fails, requiring hours of manual CSV reformatting.
SmartBulk.pain_static: Static text limitations (same description for all)
SmartBulk.solution_desc: Our Smart Engine uses pattern recognition to identify headers. It understands that "Attendee", "Recipient", and "Student" all map to the Recipient Name field.
SmartBulk.benefit_dynamic: Dynamic Text: Variablized descriptions for each record.
SmartBulk.benefit_multi: Multi-Org Support: Issue from different entities in one batch.
SmartBulk.vis_desc: The system parses raw data rows to generate unique, verifiable certificates instantly.
SmartBulk.faq_1_q: How does the heuristic mapping work?
SmartBulk.faq_1_a: The ingestion engine scans the first row of your CSV for semantic matches. It recognizes over 50 variations of common headers (e.g., "Full Name" vs "Student Name") and automatically maps them to the schema.
SmartBulk.faq_2_q: Is this included in the Professional Plan?
SmartBulk.faq_2_a: No. The Professional plan ($6/mo) includes standard Bulk Upload which requires strict template adherence. Heuristic Mapping is an advanced feature reserved for the Institutional Plan ($22/mo).

Guide.hero_desc: A complete tour of our Design Toolbox, AI Engine, and Dashboard features. Learn how to create professional certificates in seconds.
Guide.toolbox_desc: Everything you need is located on the left-hand sidebar of the editor. We've organized the tools into four intuitive categories so you can customize every inch of your certificate without getting lost.
Guide.tool_design_desc: Controls the overall look, frames, and colors.
Guide.tool_text_desc: Edits the names, titles, and signatures.
Guide.tool_paper_desc: Changes the background texture and quality.
Guide.mod_1_desc: This is where you define the "Vibe" of your award.
Guide.mod_1_feat_1_desc: Choose from our professional palettes or enter your brand's Hex Code to match your company logo perfectly.
Guide.mod_1_feat_2_desc: Switch layouts instantly. Go "Modern" for startups, or "Classic" for universities.
Guide.mod_1_feat_3_desc: Add elegance with a double-line gold border, or keep it clean with a minimalist edge.
Guide.mod_2_desc: Precision control over every word. This is the most used tool in the box.
Guide.mod_2_feat_1_desc: Upload your school or company logo here. It auto-scales to fit the header.
Guide.mod_2_feat_2_desc: Type the signer's name and title (e.g., "Elon Musk, CEO"). The system applies a handwriting font automatically.
Guide.mod_3_desc: Digital certificates don't have to feel flat. Use the Paper tool to add realistic textures that simulate physical awards.
Guide.mod_3_gold_desc: Metallic sheen perfect for 1st place awards.
Guide.mod_3_security_desc: Complex geometric security patterns used in banking.
Guide.mod_4_desc: Stuck on what to write? Don't just say "Good job." Let our AI write a meaningful commendation.
Guide.mod_4_output_text: "For demonstrating exceptional problem-solving skills and mastering complex algorithms."
Guide.account_desc: Once you've created your certificates, the Dashboard helps you organize them.
Guide.dash_desc: Your secure digital filing cabinet. Every certificate you generate (Pro/Elite) is saved here automatically. You can verify their status, re-download PDFs, or delete old records.
Guide.profile_desc: Manage your identity. Update your Password, change your Organization Name (which appears on receipts), manage your Subscription, and check your <strong_tag>Verification Badge</strong_tag> status.

GeneratorHero.subtitle: Generate <strong_tag>free, verifiable certificates</strong_tag> with AI in seconds. Every award includes a secure <strong_tag>QR code</strong_tag> and is stored permanently in the cloud.
GeneratorHero.placeholder: e.g. A certificate for John Doe for winning the 2025 Science Fair...
GeneratorHero.preset_corp_prompt: A professional Employee of the Month certificate for Sarah Jenkins, awarded by TechCorp Inc. for outstanding dedication.
GeneratorHero.preset_course_prompt: A formal Certificate of Completion awarded to Michael Chang for mastering Advanced Python. Issued by Code Academy. Date: Today.
GeneratorHero.preset_civic_prompt: Walnut City Council appreciates the Volunteer Team for their selfless support during the rainstorm.
GeneratorHero.tip_text: Mention the "Issuer" and "Date" for best results.

TemplateGallery.title: Designed to Impress.
TemplateGallery.subtitle: From official corporate recognitions to fun playful awards, our engine auto-formats your certificates perfectly.
TemplateGallery.tpl_1_desc: For demonstrating exceptional leadership and driving record sales in Q4 2024.
TemplateGallery.tpl_2_desc: Has successfully mastered the Advanced Python Programming curriculum with Honors.

VerificationSection.desc: We maintain a centralized, open-access record of every credential issued. This allows third parties (employers, universities) to audit the validity of a document instantly, without contacting the issuer.
VerificationSection.feat_id_desc: We validate the domain ownership of issuing organizations (e.g., tesla.com), attaching a "Verified Issuer" seal to the record.
VerificationSection.feat_crypto_desc: Records are frozen upon issuance. Any attempt to alter the name, date, or title invalidates the unique ID hash.

TechSpecs.title: Built for Scale & Security
TechSpecs.subtitle: Whether you are issuing one award or ten thousand, our infrastructure handles the heavy lifting.
TechSpecs.feat_1_desc: Stop formatting spreadsheets. Our AI analyzes your CSV headers (e.g., "Student Name", "Recipient") and maps them automatically, saving you hours of data cleaning.
TechSpecs.feat_2_desc: Writer's block? Just type a raw fact ("He sold 50 units"). Our composition engine expands it into formal, celebratory language suitable for professional awards.
TechSpecs.feat_3_desc: We don't just generate PDFs; we host the proof. Every certificate gets a permanent URL and database entry, ensuring it remains verifiable for years to come.

HomeDetails.step_1_desc: Describe your award ("Best Dad", "Employee of Month") and our AI generates a professional layout instantly.
HomeDetails.step_2_desc: We assign a unique 12-digit blockchain-style ID to every document. It's tamper-proof and instantly checkable.
HomeDetails.step_3_desc: Send via email or download high-res PDF. Recipients get a dedicated "Verified Page" to share on LinkedIn.
HomeDetails.sus_desc: OnlineCertificate.org is committed to keeping digital credentials accessible. Basic verification is free forever. Paid tiers support our server costs and storage permanence.
HomeDetails.std_open_desc: We use open web standards for document generation, ensuring compatibility across all devices.
HomeDetails.std_ledger_desc: Once a certificate ID is minted, it is permanently recorded in our verification database.
HomeDetails.std_privacy_desc: We do not sell user data. Verification queries are anonymous and secure by default.
HomeDetails.faq_1_a: Yes! You can design and download unlimited single certificates for free. We only charge for advanced features like uploading your own logo, bulk CSV generation, and dashboard storage.
HomeDetails.faq_2_a: Every certificate gets a unique ID. Anyone can scan the QR code or enter the ID on our Verify page to confirm it matches our records.
HomeDetails.faq_3_q: What is the difference between Pro and Elite?
HomeDetails.faq_3_a: Pro ($6) is great for businesses needing logos and bulk creation. Elite ($22) adds Manual Verification (LinkedIn/Google) and the ability to email certificates directly to recipients.
HomeDetails.cta_sub: No credit card required • Cancel anytime
